description: This Java class defines a data model for representing a Trusted Certificate Authority (CA) configuration in the Eclipse Hono framework. It includes fields for subject DN, public key, certificate, key algorithm, and validity periods, along with methods to validate, set, and get these properties. The class also handles serialization annotations for JSON processing and includes logic for certificate validation.

classes.name: TrustedCertificateAuthority
classes.description: A data model representing a trusted CA configuration with validation and accessor methods, supporting JSON serialization/deserialization and certificate validation.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the object contains all required data to be considered valid for use, including the presence of a certificate or valid public key, subject DN, and validity period.

methods.name: setSubjectDn
methods.description: Sets the subject distinguished name from a string or X500Principal object, supporting fluent API style.

methods.name: getSubjectDn
methods.description: Returns the subject distinguished name as an X500Principal, either from the certificate or stored property.

methods.name: getSubjectDnAsString
methods.description: Returns the subject distinguished name formatted as an RFC 2253 string.

methods.name: setPublicKey
methods.description: Sets the public key used by this CA from a DER-encoded byte array.

methods.name: getPublicKey
methods.description: Returns the DER-encoded public key, either from the certificate or stored property.

methods.name: setCertificate
methods.description: Sets the X.509 certificate from a DER-encoded byte array, parsing it into a Certificate object.

methods.name: setKeyAlgorithm
methods.description: Sets the algorithm name used by the public key.

methods.name: getKeyAlgorithm
methods.description: Returns the algorithm name of the public key, from the certificate or stored property.

methods.name: setNotBefore
methods.description: Sets the earliest usage date for the CA, with null check.

methods.name: getNotBefore
methods.description: Retrieves the 'not before' date, from the certificate if available or stored property.

methods.name: setNotAfter
methods.description: Sets the latest usage date for the CA, with null check.

methods.name: getNotAfter
methods.description: Retrieves the 'not after' date, from the certificate if available or stored property.
